text:
alex_chen: Quick handoff — LynxBoard (P3B) run complete. Uploaded raw logs + a CSV with perf/W, latency percentiles, and kernel cfg notes: https://drive.google.com/xxx (view-only). Summary: steady-state throughput 320 tokens/s, avg power 620W, perf/W 0.516. KV cache size impacted by seq length — see notes.

maria_garcia: awesome, thanks. can you paste the top-line config we used? helps me map to our rollout checklist.

alex_chen: sure — top line: model gptq-30b-pt, quant q4_2, cudnn kernels + our custom fused-gemm patch. Seq=2048, batch=4, affinity=single-socket.

sam_w: quick question — is the perf/W measured at host idle or with other co-tenants?

alex_chen: host was otherwise idle. we ran for 30m to hit thermal steady state. thermal throttling looked okay, no drops in perf after 20m.

jin_ops: can we get the exact bench command so infra can reproduce in our lab?
alex_chen: pasted below — run in the Lynx harness container: 

```
./bench-run --model gptq-30b-pt --quant q4_2 --seq 2048 --batch 4 --profile energy --duration 1800 --telemetry http://telemetry.redwood/internal
```

lynx_partner_bot: Documentation upload: https://s3.partner-lynx/bench/p3b/2024-09-10/logs.zip (sha256: b2c3...) :white_check_mark:

maria_garcia: next steps from partnerships side: 1) validate logs in our infra (sam + jin), 2) plan 2nd sweep with kernel toggles (fused-gemm off, matmul-tile=32), 3) align messaging for co-announcement if numbers hold.

sam_w: started a reproduction task: infra-qa/lynx-p3b-repro. I'll try exactly the command above and report perf/W + 95th pct latency.

alex_chen: FYI there's a small caveat in the notes: we disabled prefetcher X for stability which improved perf/W ~2%. Keep that in mind.

maria_garcia: thanks. if infra reproduces within 5% of perf/W, we proceed to partner messaging draft. I'll add a stub PR to partnerships repo with a draft blurb.

jin_ops: tagging ops on the telemetry schema — we want power + per-socket temp + kernel flag dump every 60s. pinging @ops-team.

alex_chen: pinging Lynx ENG for kernel tune suggestions: @lynx_partner_bot any recommended kernel toggles for next sweep?

lynx_partner_bot: Suggested toggles: [matmul_tile=32, fused_gemm=off, l2_prefetch=on]. Also recommend testing batch sizes [4,8,12] and seq lengths [1024,2048]. See internal playbook: https://lynx.partner/playbooks/kernel-tuning.pdf

sam_w: I'll log initial reproduction by EOD. If we see >7% variance we escalate to joint debug session.

maria_garcia: choreography notes for comms: we only announce if perf/W beat baseline by >10% and throughput scales linear 2x at double batch. Otherwise, internal case study only.

alex_chen: understood. I'll file a short incident-style note if reproduction fails. Otherwise, schedule a 30m sync for Monday with Lynx ENG + infra + partnerships.

lynx_partner_bot: Calendar invite proposal: Mon 9/16 10:00 PT -> created: https://calendar.redwood/event/lynx-p3b-sync. :calendar:

sam_w: got it, will attach preliminary numbers to the task once run completes.

maria_garcia: thanks team — great progress. :rocket:
